layout.principle: One copy per content, one named consumer per file; the run directory holds everything ShipLoop and the model write for the run, the product worktree holds only the product and committed knowledge.

<workspace root>/.workspace.md: keep: return route (scripts, every return-stage packet); critical for recovery of the return
<workspace root>/.return-receipt.md: keep: completion guard; previous receipt as a digest, not nested
<workspace root>/.consumer-check/: keep until done: consumer checks at release-verify; removed at done

run/.state.md: authority; read by every command; improve_results slimmed to pointer + digest + lessons
run/.request.md: the request with S1..Sn; stages that cite S<n>
run/.packets/<action>.md: recovery copy of exactly what was printed; read after a cut or lost context
run/.inbox/<action>.md, <action>-final-result: the model's result; complete and the Improve runtime read it
run/.results/<action>.md: the accepted result later stages read
run/.notes/: files a result cites (evidence) + the pass log of stages without a loop
run/.scratch/: disposable files (incl. planning probes in scratch/<action>/)
loop start (stdin) and loop receipt (resume, gate)
run/.until-loop/: live Until Loop state for every loop (inner stages and Improve)
run/.lint/: latest record per action and kind

improve/<reviewed action>/.packet.json: the runtime receipt (resume; import reads it in place, no copy)
improve/<reviewed action>/.reviews/review-<n>.md, checks.md, report: the model's pass records and the runtime's done input
improve/<reviewed action>/.receipt.md: the imported record (the one copy; state keeps a pointer)

<workspace root>/.worktree/: product files + docs/shiploop/*.md + SHIPLOOP.md only; no .shiploop-improve, no committed tool state

tree.GUIDES (skills/shiploop/references/): run-reference.md and code-craft.md as static files; state-files.md absorbs the context-index map
